items.title: Anthropic Owes $71 Billion for Compute Within a Year, “87% of Current Run Rate Revenue,” per Scott Galloway
items.summary: Key TakeawaysScott Galloway says $71 billion of Anthropic’s compute commitments come due within a year, a bill that reaches Amazon, Alphabet and Broadcom. With over $200 billion of cash after its IPO, Anthropic can pay it, so the bigger worry is its slowing revenue growth.

items.title: ASML vs. Broadcom: Which Tech Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: ASML's near-monopoly on chip-printing machines faces off against Broadcom's networking empire, with a sharp valuation gap complicating the choice for growth investors.

items.title: 3 AI Infrastructure Stocks to Watch Before Broadcom Reports on Dec. 9
items.summary: One chip giant's earnings call could swing the power plants feeding every AI data center. We ranked three infrastructure plays by beats, guidance, and customer wins, and the winner may not be the one with the biggest earnings surprise.

items.title: Billionaire Daniel Loeb’s ‘Bear Math’: AI’s $7 Trillion Spending Boom Faces a $3 Trillion Reality Check
items.summary: Tech giants are racing to build the AI future, but a hedge fund manager has run the numbers on what it must earn to pay for it. His math, and the debt market's growing unease, point to a hurdle few investors are pricing in.

items.title: The 1 Thing I'll Be Watching When Broadcom Reports on Dec. 9
items.summary: The chip designer has beaten its own AI forecast three quarters straight. Can the next outlook keep 2027 on track?

items.title: Nvidia’s Worst Losing Streak Since 2008 Now Has an SEC Problem. What Shareholders Need to Know
items.summary: A reported SEC probe, a CEO exit, and a California subpoena have hit Nvidia while its earnings keep soaring. Retirees holding the stock directly or through index funds face a hard question about which signal to trust.

items.title: Broadcom Backstops Up to $29 Billion of Anthropic’s Leases. Anthropic Just Gave Back Its IPO Pop
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBroadcom shares fell 11% today as Anthropic gave back much of its IPO pop. Broadcom expects Anthropic to be its largest custom AI chip customer in 2027.
